profileScreen.script:
import cProfile, pstats, sys
from bench_sync_producer import main
from agent_observer.sync_state import OwnerSyncCache
profile=cProfile.Profile()
original=OwnerSyncCache.publish
def measured(self,*args,**kwargs):
    return profile.runcall(original,self,*args,**kwargs)
OwnerSyncCache.publish=measured
sys.argv=[sys.argv[0],"--rows","500","--mode","sync","--workload","all-bodies"]
try:
    main()
finally:
    profile.dump_stats(".cache/dense-reconcile-500.pstats")
    with open(".cache/dense-reconcile-500-profile.txt","x") as stream:
        pstats.Stats(profile,stream=stream).strip_dirs().sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(70)
